🎟️ TOUR NEWS: Fall Out Boy announce Twilight of the Punks tour for 2027

Fall Out Boy have confirmed a 15-date European and UK run for 2027 as part of their 25th anniversary tour, opening in Prague on 17 May and closing in Lodz on 13 June. Two stops are in Germany: Mönchengladbach on 28 May and Berlin on 12 June. A Day To Remember and Neck Deep are named as support.

🎟️ TOUR NEWS: Papa Roach play five more German arenas in November
